faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DBEO Mirzapur Academic Resource Person recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Academic Resource Person posts is 17 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Academic Resource Person post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 16 vacancies announced for the Academic Resource Person position by the District Basic Education Officer Mirzapur.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduate degree along with a teacher training qualification to be eligible for the Academic Resource Person role.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the DBEO Mirzapur recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the Academic Resource Person posts is offline. Candidates need to send their filled application forms to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for the Academic Resource Person position?
faq.answer: The recruitment for the Academic Resource Person post is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q7. What is the minimum teaching experience required?
faq.answer: A minimum of 5 years of teaching experience in primary or upper primary schools is required for this position.

faq.question: Q8. What are the selection criteria for the Academic Resource Person role?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Test, followed by an Interview, and finally, a Merit List will be prepared.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Mirzapur district, which is Mirzapur.nic.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the age limit for applying to this post?
faq.answer: The specific age limit details are not provided in the summary. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for precise age criteria and any applicable relaxations.
